text: Election of the Chair of the Board of Health under Part H, Section 22 of the Board of Health Procedures By-law, as amended, for a term of office starting June 20, 2022 and ending November 14, 2022, and until a successor is appointed.
The Board of Health: 1. Elected Director Joe Mihevc as Chair of the Board of Health for a term of office starting June 20, 2022 and ending November 14, 2022, and until a successor is appointed.
